stem: Five people P, Q, R, S, T are seated around a circular table facing the centre. Q sits immediately to the right of P. S sits immediately to the right of R. T is not adjacent to P. Who sits immediately to the left of T?

per_option_rationale.rationale: Fix P at position 1 (clockwise). Q is right of P -> Q at pos 2. R,S chain: S is right of R. T not adjacent to P. Positions 3,4,5 hold T,R,S. T at pos 3 would be adjacent to Q(2) not P(1)? T not adj P: P=1, T=3 -> |3-1|=2 in circular 5: NOT adjacent. R=4, S=5. Verify S right of R: 5 is right of 4? In circular clockwise, right of pos 4 is pos 5, right of pos 5 is pos 1. YES. The arrangement clockwise: P,Q,T,R,S. Immediate left of T (pos 3) is Q (pos 2).
Confusing 'immediate left' with 'immediate right': the person to the immediate RIGHT of T is R, not Q. Selecting P as the answer confuses the reference direction in circular seating.
Ignoring the T-not-adjacent-to-P constraint allows T to sit next to P, giving an arrangement like P,Q,R,S,T where the left of T would be S or R.
Reversing the S-right-of-R clue to R-right-of-S changes the arrangement and places S as the person to T's left.

explanation: Fix P at seat 1 (clockwise arrangement). Q is right of P -> seat 2. T must not be adjacent to P: T cannot be at seat 2 (taken by Q) or seat 5 (adjacent to P on the left). So T is at seat 3. R and S fill seats 4 and 5 with S right of R -> R at 4, S at 5. Clockwise order: P(1), Q(2), T(3), R(4), S(5). Immediate left of T (seat 3) is the person at seat 2 = Q.

explanation_sections.punchline: T not adjacent to P is the key clue: it eliminates the seat next to P and forces T into a specific gap.
explanation_sections.approach: Apply clues most-certain-first: fix P at 1, Q at 2 (right of P). T not adjacent to P eliminates seats 2 and 5; T goes to seat 3 or 4. R,S chain (S right of R) needs two consecutive seats. Try T at 3: R,S at 4,5 satisfies S right of R. Immediate left of T(3) = seat 2 = Q.
explanation_sections.lesson: In circular seating, fix one person to eliminate rotation symmetry, then apply the most-restrictive clue (non-adjacency) next.
explanation_sections.timing: About 90-100 seconds. The trap is confusing immediate left with immediate right, selecting R (who is to T's right) instead of Q.
